name: Pickled Jalapeños
siboNotes: Well tolerated in typical serving sizes. The pickling process may reduce any potential FODMAPs, and peppers are naturally low FODMAP.
preparationTips: Rinse if too salty or acidic for your taste
Check ingredient labels - avoid brands with garlic or onion powder
Store opened jars in refrigerator and use within recommended time
Slice fresh jalapeños and quick-pickle in vinegar for homemade version
